title: Pathway crosswalk and concordance for the DELPHI zebrafish gene universe

gene_universe.caveat: The universe was drawn from genes that already had a pathway in genotype/pathways.json (GO BP, Reactome or KEGG), so pathway coverage of it is high by construction.

method.key_pathways: Per source, a gene is a member if it is in any selected pathway (Reactome: all-levels file, so members of sub-pathways count; GO: annotated, NOT dropped, to the root term or any descendant via is_a, part_of or (positively/negatively) regulates). Core sources: GO, Reactome, KEGG, WikiPathways. Pathway Commons (PID/PANTHER/NetPath/INOH, human, through ZFIN orthology) is a fifth, borrowed, source reported separately.
method.crosswalk: Gene sets over all ZFIN genes (not just the universe). For each KEGG, WikiPathways and Reactome (top-level and their direct children with >=10 genes) pathway, the top 3 matches in every other source by Jaccard (ties broken by name-token overlap), J >= 0.05. 'mutual_best' lists pairs that are each other's best Jaccard match.
method.independence_caveat: These sources are not independent. Reactome dre is wholly inferred from human; KEGG assigns genes to reference maps by orthology; 30 of 55 zebrafish WikiPathways are HomologyConvert-ed from human; GO IBA rows are phylogenetic transfers. Agreement among orthology-derived sources partly reflects shared human ancestry of the annotation, not separate zebrafish evidence. GO experimental membership is given separately.
